text: おっきい　ほうの　ガラガラが　みつからねえんだ！

structure.jp: おっきい　ほうの　ガラガラが

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねえ is a rough male way of saying ない, 'not'. みつからねえ = 'can't be found'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and adds the feeling of explaining your situation. みつからねえんだ = 'the thing is, I can't find it'.

patterns.name: 〜ほう
patterns.span: おっきい　ほうの　ガラガラ
patterns.explanation: ほう after a describing word picks one of two things: 'the one that is...'. おっきい　ほうの　ガラガラ = 'the bigger one, Marowak'.
